questions.question: A land with existing Blight has two Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B. One new Blight is added after setup. Describe Presence losses, cascade choices and what happens if the cascade enters another already-Blighted land.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A land with existing Blight has two Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B. One new Blight is added after setup. Describe Presence losses, cascade choices and what happens if the cascade enters another already-Blighted land.
required_facts: Destroy one Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B.
Add the original Blight and cascade one additional Blight to one chosen adjacent land.
If that land already had Blight, destroy one Presence of each Spirit present and cascade onward again.
Existing Blight quantity does not multiply the outgoing cascade.

key_context_not_required.fact: Put destroyed Presence beside the island, not back on the Presence tracks.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This is storage after the asked loss, not a separately requested destination.

questions.question: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A card adds a Town in Slow and says Invaders skip Build this turn. What remains next turn? At Time Passes where do played cards go, what happens to damaged survivors and reminder markers, and do track Elements vanish?
required_facts: The added Town stays next turn as a board change.
The turn's Build-skip effect expires at Time Passes.
Discard played cards to personal discard and clear card Elements.
Heal survivor Damage and remove temporary effects/reminder markers.

questions.question: May a newly gained Growth Power be played in the same Spirit Phase? Does a Power gained in Fast automatically enter play or resolve immediately, and is there a hand-size or hand-secrecy limit?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May a newly gained Growth Power be played in the same Spirit Phase? Does a Power gained in Fast automatically enter play or resolve immediately, and is there a hand-size or hand-secrecy limit?
required_facts: A Growth-gained card may be played later in the same Spirit Phase.
A Fast-gained card does not automatically enter play.
Gaining that card in Fast does not automatically resolve its effects immediately.
There is no hand-size limit and cards may be shown to others.

key_context_not_required.fact: Even when a separate effect explicitly permits playing a card, that permission alone does not automatically resolve it immediately.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks about a newly gained Power. It does not stipulate an effect explicitly playing that card; that is the separate premise of Q38.

key_context_not_required.fact: A newly gained Power normally goes to hand.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: Q37 asks same-phase play eligibility and automatic play/resolution, not its destination. Q17 directly asks the destination.

questions.question: If a Ravage in one land cascades Blight across the board boundary, is that cascade a separate independent action for victory/defeat checks? May players choose another land’s Ravage first to win before a later losing Ravage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Ravage in one land cascades Blight across the board boundary, is that cascade a separate independent action for victory/defeat checks? May players choose another land’s Ravage first to win before a later losing Ravage?
required_facts: A cascade is part of the original single-land Ravage action tree, including across boards.
It is not an independent outcome-check boundary.
Players may choose the land order and win after one complete Ravage tree before a later land would cause loss.

questions.question: If a human piece remains illegally placed after an action tree, how is it cleaned up? Is that a move, destroy, remove or action, and what if no legal land exists?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a human piece remains illegally placed after an action tree, how is it cleaned up? Is that a move, destroy, remove or action, and what if no legal land exists?
required_facts: After the action tree, clean an illegally placed human to the nearest legal land, using judgment/physical distance if unclear.
Cleanup is not movement, Destroy, Remove or an action.
If no legal land exists, return it to supply as cleanup.

key_context_not_required.fact: This correction precedes the outcome check.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks cleanup, its classification, and the no-legal-land case; it does not ask outcome-check timing.
This is a consequence beyond the specifically asked move/Destroy/Remove/action classifications.
